datasets.annotation_method: Annotators created synthetic product reviews in English based on curated product aspects, then manually translated them into 13 Indic languages.

data_creator_info.evidence: Ethics Statement: 'All the annotators were native speakers of the respective languages and from the Indian subcontinent.' 'Annotators who participated in the annotation and/or verification task are paid a competitive monthly salary.' 2 annotators per language.

datasets.notes: 13-way parallel dataset. Reviews are synthetic (written by annotators for real products) not collected from real user reviews. 156 dev instances, 1000 test instances per language.

datasets.variant_notes: Based on XNLI; machine translated by Aggarwal et al. (2022) with ongoing human verification by this paper's authors.
datasets.annotation_method: Machine translated from XNLI English by Aggarwal et al. (2022). This paper performs ongoing manual verification and correction of translations. Human verification is in progress (see Appendix I).

data_creator_info.creator_affiliation: Originally by Aggarwal et al. (2022); verification by AI4Bharat / IIT Madras
data_creator_info.evidence: Original IndicXNLI by Aggarwal et al. 2022 used machine translation. This paper notes ongoing human verification. No demographic info for original translators reported.

datasets.source_reference: Aggarwal et al. 2022 (IndicXNLI); originally from Conneau et al. 2018 (XNLI)
datasets.notes: 2490 dev, 5010 test instances per language. Human verification is in progress; partial corrections have been made (see Appendix I, Table 9). Footnote states 'Human verification is in progress'.

datasets.variant_notes: Manual translation of the English COPA test set into 18 Indic languages.
datasets.annotation_method: Manually translated from the English COPA test set. Premises and choices were randomized and assigned to translators to avoid bias, then re-grouped after translation.

data_creator_info.evidence: Ethics Statement: 'All the annotators were native speakers of the respective languages and from the Indian subcontinent.' 'paid a competitive monthly salary'

datasets.notes: Test-only (500 instances per language). Fine-tuning uses English Social IQA (Sap et al. 2019).

datasets.annotation_method: 1001 English sentences were machine-translated into 10 languages using IndicTrans, then verified and corrected by human annotators. Annotators then manually created paraphrases and non-paraphrases for each translated sentence in the target language.

data_creator_info.evidence: Ethics Statement: 'All the annotators were native speakers of the respective languages and from the Indian subcontinent.' 'paid a competitive monthly salary.' 2 annotators per language.

datasets.source_reference: Source sentences from Kumar et al. 2022 (IndicNLG Suite)
datasets.notes: Test-only (2002 instances per language). Results in 1001-way parallel <sentence, paraphrase, non-paraphrase> triplets. Source sentences are translated but paraphrases are natively created.

datasets.variant_name: MASSIVE (Intent Classification subset for 7 Indic languages)
datasets.variant_notes: Subset of 7 Indic languages from the MASSIVE dataset used for intent classification.
datasets.annotation_method: Professionally translated from English user queries collected by Amazon Alexa. Contains 60 intents.

data_creator_info.evidence: INSUFFICIENT_INFO: Original MASSIVE dataset by FitzGerald et al. 2022. This paper does not report annotator demographics or compensation for the MASSIVE dataset.

datasets.notes: 2033 dev, 2974 test instances per language. English train and validation sets used for fine-tuning. Full MASSIVE dataset covers 51 languages; only 7 Indic languages used here.

datasets.annotation_method: For English-Indic parallel sentence pairs, English sentences were NER-tagged using an off-the-shelf model, tags were automatically projected to Indic sentences via word alignments, then verified and corrected by human annotators. IOB2 format.

data_creator_info.evidence: INSUFFICIENT_INFO: Naamapadam was proposed in Mhaske et al. (2022). This paper does not detail annotator demographics or compensation for Naamapadam specifically.

datasets.notes: Dev sizes vary (52-13460), test sizes vary (607-1080) per language. Training uses CoNLL-2003 English data.

datasets.variant_name: MASSIVE (Slot Filling subset for 7 Indic languages)
datasets.variant_notes: Subset of 7 Indic languages from the MASSIVE dataset used for slot filling.
datasets.annotation_method: Professionally translated from English user queries collected by Amazon Alexa. Contains 55 slot types.

data_creator_info.evidence: INSUFFICIENT_INFO: Original MASSIVE dataset by FitzGerald et al. 2022. This paper does not report annotator demographics or compensation for the MASSIVE dataset.

datasets.notes: Same underlying data as MASSIVE-Intent but evaluated as a separate task. 2033 dev, 2974 test instances per language.

datasets.annotation_method: Manually curated cloze-style reading comprehension dataset. Context paragraphs chosen from Wikipedia articles on topics related to Indic culture, history, etc. Questions created in Indic languages by annotators. Two-phase process: (1) context translated to English, annotators create questions from translated context to reduce lexical overlap, (2) original Indic context presented to different annotators to mark answer spans.

data_creator_info.evidence: Ethics Statement: 'All the annotators were native speakers of the respective languages and from the Indian subcontinent.' 'paid a competitive monthly salary.' 2-3 annotators per language. Annotations done on Haystack tool.

datasets.notes: 18,579 total questions (13,283 answerable, 5,292 unanswerable). Created from scratch without translation from English sources. Context paragraphs are from Indic-language Wikipedia on culturally relevant topics. Fine-tuning uses English SQuAD.

datasets.variant_notes: Indic language subset of FLORES-101/200 used as a sentence retrieval task.
datasets.annotation_method: N-way parallel dataset with sentences manually translated by professional translators.

data_creator_info.evidence: INSUFFICIENT_INFO: FLORES is from Goyal et al. 2022 and Costa-jussà et al. 2022. This paper does not report FLORES annotator details.

datasets.source_reference: Goyal et al. 2022 (FLORES-101); Costa-jussà et al. 2022 (FLORES-200 / No Language Left Behind)
datasets.notes: 1012 test sentences per language. No fine-tuning performed; mean-pooled representations from the model's final layer are used for retrieval.
